items: Each reducer pulls only its own partition files from every mapper
The k-way merge keeps one line per file in RAM while grouping keys
Same-key records arrive together, sorted, ready to group
cards.title: Fetch, Merge, Group

items: A checksum mismatch fails one partition fetch, not the job
The lost mapper reruns from its split under a fresh attempt id
All other map-output files stay: rerun is scoped, not global
cards.title: Lost Files Recompute

items: The combiner pre-aggregates inside the mapper before any network
Less shuffle traffic for combinable work like counts and sums
Not every function combines: average needs sum plus count
cards.title: Combiner Pays for Itself
